static_traits.name: Zhang Wen
static_traits.family_status: 与配偶及子Female同住,Family relationships紧密,互相支持
static_traits.social_status: 与上司Relationship tension;更倾向于就Work问题寻求专业帮助而非打扰家人
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness;without既往心理咨询或治疗史;以往not yet出现类似心理问题
static_traits.language_features: Tone neutral; able to clearly describe concrete work situations and feelings; highly cooperative, willing to try cognitive-behavioral experiments; able to conduct self-observation and give examples

basic_info.main_problem: 每周Work超过60小时,持续担心过度Work会导致被解雇,该Fear引发显著压力与Anxiety,影响Work专注与家庭休息.
basic_info.core_demands: Hoping through counseling to relieve the persistent fear of losing the job, improve mental health and overall well-being, so as to be more focused at work and more relaxed at home.

core_beliefs: I may be fired at any time

special_situations.event: Last month the restaurant held a large event, completed smoothly overall
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not做到完美或超出目标,就说明I am not good enough,Worknot保
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加班投入更多时间准备;在高压时段进行短暂休息与深呼吸来压住Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这not算,我还是not做够,可能会被解雇

special_situations.event: 上司在Work场合露出严肃的表情或反馈not够积极
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果上司have not明确表扬或面色严肃,就代表我表现not合格,职位岌岌可危
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 更用力Work,延长工时以弥补可能的not足,尽量减少错误
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他对我not满,我很可能会被辞退

special_situations.event: Missing a small deadline last week
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Any mistake will bring serious consequences (such as being fired)
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加班赶工,持续紧张地Self-monitoring任务进度
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is over; they are going to fire me this time

special_situations.event: Workload increases significantly; works over 60 hours per week
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我without法在高负荷下仍然完美达成所有目标,那么过度Work也会被视为without能,终将被解雇
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Persistently works overtime to prove themselves; arranges short breaks and deep breathing at work to maintain state
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Overworking will instead lead to being fired; things will be terrible

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized by her supervisor, to maintain job safety and stability
core_conflict.fear: 害怕not够好被negate,最终被解雇与失去保障
defense_goal: Maintains performance and reduces the risk of being fired through overtime work and self-control
尽量not让家人担心,将问题控制在可承受范围内

object_relations.self_representation: 紧张not安,随时可能被淘汰的员工

manifestations: 在高压Work环境下感到Restricted choices
Works more than 60 hours a week to meet external goals
Self-worth is highly bound to the boss's evaluation and work performance

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Treats the boss's performance targets as absolute standards that must be met
把'任何错误都会让我丢Work'的信条not yet经检验地内化

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on.
manifestations: 在面对负面反馈或挑战性任务时过度自我批评,反复担心'not够好'
not想让家人过度担心而倾向于将压力对内处理

exception_events.target_problem: 在错过截止时间时,来访者通常会灾难化预测并认为自己会被解雇,Anxiety intensified,难以专注Work.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Missing a small deadline last week后,来访者并not yet被解雇,且通过短暂休息与深呼吸缓解Anxiety并继续完成Work.
exception_events.reason: 线索:采取了短暂休息与深呼吸的not同做法;not同证据:以往也曾错过小截止但not yet被警告或解雇,上司并not yet明确表示职位有风险.

exception_events.target_problem: Under the pressure of large events, the client usually ignores positive outcomes and persistently worries about being fired.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 上个月餐厅大型活动整体顺利完成,来访者成功组织并推进准备Work,事实与其灾难化预测not一致.
exception_events.reason: Cue: the smooth outcome of the activity provided contrary evidence; arranging brief rests and deep breathing amid busyness to maintain state helped them complete the key task.

positive_force: Has a supportive family system; willing to confide
Actively seeks professional help and is willing to participate in behavioral experiments
Having basic stress management methods (short breaks, deep breathing)
Still able to complete key tasks under high load (large events going smoothly)
negative_force: 灾难化,negate积极,心理过滤,预测not yet来等认知偏差显著
Self-worth highly dependent on external evaluation (boss's goals and feedback)
Long-term high-intensity overtime causes excessive physical and mental load
与上司Relationship tension,负面反馈易triggerAnxiety

target_behavior.behavior: Work相关的高度Anxiety与灾难化预测(持续担心被解雇)
antecedent: Encountering a difficult task at work
错过小的截止时间或not yet达目标
Workload has increased significantly (more than 60 hours a week)
target_behavior.core_reason: 在高压与高期望环境下,将外界业绩标准not yet经消化地内化为个人价值,伴随灾难化,心理过滤,negate积极与预测not yet来等认知偏差,导致对被解雇的过度担忧.
target_behavior.function: 通过加班与过度努力来逃避'not够好'的感受并寻求外部认可与安全感;通过短暂休息与深呼吸来缓解即时Anxiety.
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased work focus与绩效受影响;与上司Relationship tension;睡眠质量变差;Daily functioning impaired;持续的压力与Anxiety.
